## Introduction

This report explores the Palmer Penguins dataset using R.

The analysis compares body mass among three penguin
species: Adelie, Chinstrap, and Gentoo.

Data manipulation and visualisation are performed
using the tidyverse package.
```{r}

## Average Body Mass by Species



library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)

penguin_summary <- penguins %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_mass_g = mean(body_mass_g, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

knitr::kable(penguin_summary)
```
## Penguin Body Mass by Species and Island

```{r}
ggplot(penguins, aes(x = species, y = body_mass_g, fill = island)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    title = "Penguin Body Mass by Species and Island",
    x = "Penguin Species",
    y = "Body Mass (g)",
    fill = "Island"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
